findings.title: Claim's selector stops its StorageClass provisioning a volume
findings.cause: PersistentVolumeClaim data has a selector, tier=fast, and the provisioner of StorageClass standard does not provision a volume for a claim with one: a selector picks among PersistentVolumes that already exist, and no volume with those labels does; the provisioner says: failed to provision volume with StorageClass "standard": claim.Spec.Selector is not supported

evidence.command: kubectl get pvc data -n kd-pvc-selector-dynamic -o jsonpath='{.status.phase}'
kubectl get pvc data -n kd-pvc-selector-dynamic -o jsonpath='{.spec.selector}'

evidence.detail: failed to provision volume with StorageClass "standard": claim.Spec.Selector is not supported

findings.fix: Remove the selector to have the class provision a volume (a claim's selector cannot be changed: recreate the claim), or create a PersistentVolume with those labels and the claim's storageClassName for it to bind to.
